up: Retrieve all activity records for assay CHEMBL1614481. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, and the exact activity value, standard relation, standard units, and standard type for each record.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_type
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614481';
